h1: Custom Shopify store apps, built for one shop
overview: When no app in the store does exactly what you need, we build one just for you. It might sync orders to a spreadsheet, add a wholesale price rule, print custom packing slips or tag customers automatically. The app is installed only on your store, so there is no review process and no public listing. You own the code, and we explain how it runs and how to update it.

faq: How is a custom app different from a public one?
A custom app is installed on your store only. It needs no App Store review and has no listing or pricing plans. It is the fastest route to a feature that only you need.
On a small hosting service that you own, such as a low-cost cloud host. We set it up and tell you the expected monthly cost first, which is often small for store-sized workloads.
Not for most custom apps. Some features, such as certain checkout customizations, depend on your Shopify plan. We check this when we review your request and tell you before you order.
Can it become a public app later?
Yes, with extra work. Public apps need billing, privacy handling and App Store review. We keep the code clean so that move is possible, and can quote it as a build service.
